roles.responsibility: Own run/clock/Job/root configuration binding, consume one-time in-memory resume eligibility, inhibit future dispatch and request owned-target stop independently of blocked query
Only designated completion-port receiver and class 13 query caller; pre-register in-flight calls and handle-use rights, publish observations and classification
Observe registered progress/deadline state without waiting for reader/query return or their lock/queue; latch stop inhibition on expiry or publication failure
Serialize state versions, reservation lifecycle, pending classification, monotone latches and operation eligibility
Check completed evidence and independently trusted expected contract/authority; emit only a bounded-scope decision after all required axes

serialization_rules: Critical state transition sections do not wait for OS calls, query, writer/readback or target termination
Reserve a receive before entering the wait; retain reservation until timeout/error/packet result is published
Publish received notification and pending classification before query entry; query deadline starts at dequeue/observation, not API entry
Reserve query and its handle-use rights before entry; retain until return has been validated and published
If reader stops between dequeue and publication, preserve unknown packet details rather than inventing them; independently detected reader failure inhibits dispatch
Normal queue saturation or target-held locks cannot be prerequisites for expiry publication or dispatch inhibition
Both coherent state-owner eligibility and independent supervisor inhibition state must permit dispatch; missing, stale or unreachable required state blocks it
The production synchronization primitive, visibility and failure behavior are not selected here

eligibility_requires: future adopted contract and operational risk terms plus explicit run authority
bound reader readiness and independent monitor
valid new-mode other-resource assessment under original origins
valid numeric deadlines and remaining superior budget
not previously consumed for this run
startup.late_observed_event: Revoke unconsumed eligibility; once dispatch entered, latch stop and use independently verified owned-target stop path
startup.PID_not_yet_reported_gap: Keep official NOTIFICATION_LIMIT non-sending condition explicit; no message is not membership/identity/current-safety proof

normal_final_precedence: F0 register immutable final start and block new owned admission
F1 verify owned Job/root termination while reader remains active
F2 finish managed classification and start provisional writer only while normal eligibility holds
F3 guarded provisional readback; reader continues observation
F5 process every already reserved receive result and required query; commit managed cutoff only when predicates hold
F6 verify reader actual exit then safe dependent handle cleanup
F7 complete separate closure evidence tied to provisional bytes and post-writer observations
F8 Parent verifies all required axes and latest state/version under the original final deadline

cutoff.request_effect: Atomically prohibit new receive reservations, not discard existing receives or their returned packets
cutoff.allow_after_request: Only classification and queries needed for already admitted work; no new ordinary receive
commit_predicates: state version and last applied sequence captured consistently
cutoff.new_receive_after_cutoff: Protocol error, retain evidence, block normal acceptance
cutoff.unreceived_queued_or_in_transit_events: Excluded/uncertain under explicitly selected finite scope, never recorded as absent

blocked_query.owned_target_stop: Independent, verified and already authorized ownership-bound path only; requests and actual exits are separate facts

if_only_safe_handle_release_unproven_aft.cutoff: Preserve independently satisfied commit predicates if established; do not infer them from query return alone

blocked_query.independent_exit_facts: Preserve actual reader and owned-native exit observations on their own axes; neither erase confirmed exits nor infer query return/publication/safe handle release from exits
blocked_query.separate_query_worker_process: Alternative requiring separate lifecycle/resource/ownership design and approval, not selected

evidence_object_separation.P: Immutable provisional file with only pre-write facts; no own write-completion, readback, finish-time or full-record hash in its body
evidence_object_separation.C: Later closure object references completed P bytes and separate post-write/readback records; no rewrite of P or certification of C's own future storage
evidence_object_separation.R: Parent reads completed P/C and linked records; its own later storage/delivery is checked by the consumer, not recursively self-certified

deadlines.start: Initial: earlier bound monitor registration or reader start request; repeated: prior validated processing-step completion
deadlines.expiry: Block resume or latch monitoring error and STOP_REQUIRED

deadlines.start: Notification dequeue/observation through publication of validated classification
deadlines.expiry: UNRESOLVED_NOTIFICATION and STOP_REQUIRED; prior OS delivery delay excluded

deadlines.start: First final entry starting new-owned-admission block through required final acceptance evidence and verification

deadline_common.effective_boundary: minimum of immutable_start + adopted_duration and all applicable superior absolute deadlines
deadline_common.at_or_after_effective_boundary: Proposed expiry rule; completion recorded at equality does not establish before-deadline completion
deadline_common.completion_vs_expiry: Require validated completion timestamp and publication before effective boundary; later publication or unresolved ordering is not accepted

Preserve required other resources and origins; specify assessor/control integration without current substitution
Evidence for return/cleanup method or explicit unresolved containment procedure; no undocumented cancellation claim
